correctness.rationale: The actual 36-dimensional stochastic Liouvillian reproduces the six-variable closure at 100 independently integrated physical test instances. Reflection splits the exact generator into z,Q,P factors. Routh--Hurwitz shifted polynomials strictly separate the quadratic and cubic spectral abscissae for every λ>0; the center Laplace numerator has no pole cancellation. The cubic discriminant has a unique positive zero, and analytic implicit-derivative signs prove strict increase/decrease of the cubic relaxation gap around that point. Numerical finite checks are corroborating, not infinite proofs. The rate is a limsup logarithmic population exponent.

value.rationale: A length-three path is the first physical hopping chain with two independent, noncommuting stochastic bonds. The rigorously sharp switching-rate optimum depends on whether its middle or end site is populated (ratio about 1.627), an informative physical design benchmark. A cubic double-root exceptional point governs the center optimum, unlike the endpoint quadratic critical damping; the observable-sector distinction is not a routine generic telegraph formula. Scope is confined to ensemble population relaxation, equal bond magnitudes and stationary independent symmetric noise.
